selected_script.angle: Stop wasting time scrubbing greasy kitchen splatter with dish soap; use one spray to cut grease fast across real kitchen mess zones.
selected_script.hook: Stop scrubbing greasy splatter with dish soap.

script_record.pain_point: Greasy kitchen splatter takes too much effort when people scrub with dish soap and a wet sponge, leaving smears behind.
script_record.conflict_hook: A hand aggressively scrubs greasy microwave-door splatter with a soapy sponge, but the surface still looks cloudy and streaky.
script_record.product_solution: Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser is brought into the same messy area, sprayed directly onto the grease, then wiped clean quickly with no visible residue.

voiceover.0-3s: Stop scrubbing greasy splatter with dish soap.
voiceover.3-6s: I spray Liapu right on the mess and wipe it away.
voiceover.6-10s: It cuts through the oily film fast, without that sticky residue.
voiceover.10-14s: I use it on cabinet handles, the microwave, and stove areas.
voiceover.14-18s: It leaves a fresh lemon scent and helps kill 99.9% of bacteria.

timeline.scene: Close-up in a real American kitchen: a hand scrubs greasy orange splatter on a microwave door edge with a wet soapy sponge. The sponge pushes the grease around and leaves cloudy streaks. No product visible yet.

The Liapu white cylindrical spray bottle with yellow front label enters frame. A hand sprays the cleaner directly onto the greasy splatter, then wipes once with a white paper towel. The surface starts looking clearer immediately.

Fast-cut close-up of the cleaned microwave exterior and nearby counter edge. Product stays standing upright on the white quartz countertop with label facing camera. The wiped area looks clean, bright, and non-streaky.

Different usage environment in the same kitchen: greasy cabinet handles near the stove. A hand sprays Liapu lightly, wipes the handle and cabinet edge, and places the bottle beside the cabinet with the yellow label visible.

Final fast-cut near the range hood exterior: light oil film is sprayed and wiped away. The clean stainless surface reflects warm kitchen light. The product remains central and visible on the counter in the foreground.

Clean kitchen counter hero moment: Liapu bottle upright in the center, white bottle body, yellow label, trigger sprayer, translucent liquid level visible. A hand gives a small satisfied tap on the counter beside it.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText:
Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, 9:16, realistic handheld UGC phone-shot style in a modern American kitchen with white quartz counters, stainless appliances, natural daylight mixed with warm indoor light. No platform UI, no watermark, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays.

Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity: Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser, white smooth plastic cylindrical spray bottle, trigger sprayer mechanism, translucent bottle showing liquid level, yellow front-center label with the text CLEAN UP KITCHEN OIL STAINS and NET: 500ml. Do not change product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, ports, decorative parts, or exaggerated functions. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve product material, side structure, edge shape, texture, and visible details. Use the function reference image only to understand real spray-and-wipe usage; do not copy poster layouts or invent new functions.

Timeline:
0-3s: Show a real-life wrong or inefficient behavior using close-up details to amplify the pain point. Start tight on a greasy microwave door edge and nearby counter splatter. A natural adult hand scrubs hard with a wet soapy sponge, but the orange-brown oily residue smears into cloudy streaks instead of coming clean. Do not show the product yet. The spoken hook is: “Stop scrubbing greasy splatter with dish soap.”
3-6s: Quickly introduce the product as the direct solution and show the issue being fixed immediately. The Liapu spray bottle enters from the side, label facing camera for a brief clear view. The hand sprays 2 short pumps directly onto the greasy microwave-door splatter, then wipes once with a white paper towel. The oily film visibly loosens and clears naturally, without magical effects.
6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result. Show a quick close-up pan across the cleaned microwave exterior and the counter edge. The surface looks bright, clean, and non-streaky. Keep the Liapu bottle standing upright on the white quartz counter, central and visible, yellow label facing camera. Voiceover: “I spray Liapu right on the mess and wipe it away. It cuts through the oily film fast, without that sticky residue.”

Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. Natural spray sound, sponge friction, paper towel wiping sound, and handheld phone movement are encouraged. No split screens, no before-after poster layout, no arrows, no germ icons, no percentage graphics.

The cabinet handle and edge look clean and free of oily fingerprints. Voiceover: “I use it on cabinet handles, the microwave, and stove areas.”
4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing final result, cleanliness, and improved usage. Cut to a stainless range hood exterior with a light oily film. The stainless surface becomes clean and softly reflective under warm kitchen light. Voiceover: “It leaves a fresh lemon scent and helps kill 99.9% of bacteria.”
8-10s: Short CTA. Clean kitchen counter hero moment: Liapu bottle upright in the center on the white quartz countertop, white bottle body, yellow label, trigger sprayer, and translucent liquid level visible. A hand gives a small satisfied tap on the counter beside it. Voiceover: “Make kitchen cleanup easier.”
